title: Bitcoin ETFs Notch Seven-Day Winning Streak as 2026 Flows Turn Green
preview: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn nearly $3 billion over seven straight sessions, erasing post-Clarity Act losses and pushing 2026 flows back into positive territory.

title: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
preview: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves. Will it be enough?

title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
preview: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.

title: Google Just Made Free 1080p AI Video Generation Available to Anyone
preview: Google Vids now lets any Google account holder generate free HD AI video using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, with new scene, timing, and watermark controls.

title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
preview: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.

title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
preview: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.
